description: Reviewed reduced-dimensional ValleyScope EBR package-data catalog
convention_source_description: Production irrep/EBR convention source is Bilbao/irreptables. Legacy C2/C3 phase-label tables and their aliases are validation fixtures only and are marked with convention_source: "irreptables_reduced_legacy_phase_label" to distinguish them from irreptables-derived production tables.

tables.name: P321_C3_like_GammaM_KM_spinful_v1
tables.review_method: Codex condensed-matter review of Bilbao-derived irreptables SG150 spinful character data, C3 signoff packet, and pinned reduced-vector tests
tables.source_reference: Bilbao Crystallographic Server SG150 spinful irreps and EBRs via public irreptables
tables.note: Legacy name retained for backward compatibility. Prefer P3_GammaM_KM_spinful_v1 for new work. This table uses legacy C3 phase labels, not Bilbao/irreptables irrep labels.

tables.name: P3_GammaM_KM_spinful_v1
tables.review_method: Codex condensed-matter review of the existing SG150/P321 parent-table reduced vectors as a P3 valley-projected subspace basis alias
tables.source_reference: Bilbao Crystallographic Server SG150 spinful irreps and EBRs via public irreptables; reviewed parent-to-subspace reduction restricted to the P3 valley-preserving subgroup
tables.note: Physical P3 subspace-space-group identity alias. The table subspace_group_candidate is P3, while table provenance.space_group_number remains 150 because this is the reviewed SG150 parent-to-P3 reduced table, not an independently reviewed SG143 source table. Uses legacy C3 phase labels via reviewed basis map.

basis_maps.name: P3_Bilbao_to_phase_label_v1
basis_maps.review_method: Character-based mapping of SG143 spinful irreps to legacy C3 phase labels; verified against generic P3 validation benchmark
basis_maps.source_reference: Bilbao Crystallographic Server SG143 spinful irreps via public irreptables
